content:
[Intro]
[Dm]
[Cm]
[A7]
[G]

[Verse 1]
[Dm]You never need,
you’re American
[Cm]You never take
what you say
[A7]seriously
[G]
[Dm]You’re on the bed
You’re on the ledge of things
[Cm]You’ve got it made
And when you wake
[A7]It’s all in
vain
[G]

[Verse 2]
[Dm]You never said
you’d do anything
[Cm]You made
excuses for your
[A7]mind Ob-
jective goal and
[G]collective
Don’t you dare for-
[Dm]get it
Don’t you for-
[Cm]get it
Don’t you for-
[A7]get
Don’t do it
[G]

[Verse 3]
[Dm]In the age
of military
[Cm]You are engaged
with such
[A7]fanfare activity
You let them do
[G]things as they please
[Dm]In a grave,
you’re accounted for
[Cm]If you were
red you’d be spoken for
[A7]Your color blue
is gray
[G]

[Verse 4]
[Dm]In the arms
of the one you love
[Cm]You feel safe,
you feel so above
[A7]The
hunger on the streets
[G]
[Dm]With your safe
And your document
[Cm]in its place
Your money, your
[A7]gun Your
conscience, sweet like
[G]honey
[Dm]You forbade
yourself to think
[Cm]See where you are
as you begin to sink
[A7]In your mirror,
in your mirror
[G]In your mirror,
in your face

[Outro]
[Dm]
[Cm]
[A7]
[G]In your mirror,
in your face
[Dm]
[Cm]
[A7]
[G]
[Dm]
[Cm]
[A7]

[Fade Out]
[G]
title: In Your Face
tuning: E A D G B E
